title: Covariant One-Loop Corrections from a Non-Covariant Expansion: The Scalar Field Case
authors: Lucas Ducastelo de C. C. Lima
summary: We compute the one-loop correction to the non-minimal coupling of a scalar field theory to gravity, induced by a quartic self-interaction. We adopt the non-covariant framework of linearized gravity and explicitly compute the corresponding Feynman diagram, including both the divergent and the finite parts. The corresponding contribution to the one-loop effective action is obtained by the requirement of covariance and compared with the known results obtained by the heat kernel technique.
